Item 1. Business · Item 1A. Risk Factors

Item 1. Business

Penguin Solutions supplies advanced computing, integrated memory, and optimized LED products. Its Advanced Computing business designs, deploys, and manages AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. OriginAI combines validated hardware architectures with ClusterWareAI management software and expert deployment services. The Stratus brand supplies fault-tolerant computing systems. Integrated Memory develops specialized DRAM and storage modules for demanding customer systems. Optimized LED serves separate industrial and lighting applications.

Competition

The business competes with global computing and memory providers on customer requirements, product quality, service, supply reliability, and price. Some larger competitors have greater scale and purchasing power. Competition can affect margins, customer wins, and the timing of project deployments.

Demand and component supply can vary.
